Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 6880- 1972 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
MACHINE, SEWIAN (VERMICELLI) 



Reaffirmed 2002 ] 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements of SEWIAN (vermicelli) machine used for extrusion 
of SEWIAN. 

2. Material 

2.1 Body, Die-Holder ( Socket ), Handle, Fly-Nut and Feed Worm — Iron casting conforming to any grade 
of IS : 210-1 962 ' Specification for grey iron castings ( revised ) ', 

2.2 Perforated Dies — Shall be either of brass sheet conforming to Designation CuZn40 of IS : 41 0-1 967 
'Specification for rolled brass plate, sheet, strip and foil {second revision)' or stainless steel of 
Designation 04Cr19Ni9or 07Cr19Ni9 of Schedule V pf IS: 1570-1961 ' Schedules for wrought 
steels for general engineering purposes', with the following thickness: 



Brass 
Stainless steel 



1-25 mm 
0'71 mm 



2.3 Screws— Mild steel wire, conforming to IS : 1673-1960 ' Specification for mild steel wire for the 
manufacture of machine screws ( by cold heading process ) '. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

4. Workmansliip and Finlsli 

4.1 The feed worm shall be concentric with the bore in the machine body. It shall have wider spacing 
at the hopper side and converging towards the die end. 

4.2 The treads and serrations, wherever provided, shall be well-formed and clean, 

4.3 The various components shall have good workmanship. 

4.4 The casting shall be free from blow holes, pits, cracks and other casting defects. 

4.5 The die shall have well-formed and clean perforations according to the sizes given in the figure. 

4.6 The die shall be punched, die-pressed and seated flush with the die-holder to avoid the leakage of 

dough. 

4.7 Each machine shall be provided with minimum two dies of different sizes. 

4.8 Every component of the machine shall be nickel plated in accordance with Service Grade No. 1 of 
IS: 1068-1968 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel 
(revised) '. 

5. Performance Test — A dough shall be prepared stiff by kneading MAIDA with cold or lukewarm 
water. The dough shallthen be fed in the hopper of the machine which is fitted on a suitable place. 
The feed worm shall be rotated anti-clockwise by the handle. The vermicelli of the size as required by 
the producer shall come out through the die which shall then be spread in the dry atmosphere. The 
vermicelli so formed shall be of uniform size and shall come out from the die in a continuous length. 
The dough shall not leak from any other part of the machine. The machine after this operation shall not 
show any sign of damage. 

6. Marking — Shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark and the 
country of origin. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 30 October 1972 



® IVIay 1973, ISI
